name: Columns
description: One row, one cell per column (text, images, links). On phones the columns stack.

visualCharacteristics.purpose: two or more content cells side by side

options.label: split-62, portrait-235
options.description: Unequal story row: the first cell takes 62% (split-NN = NN%); portrait-NNN is the display width in px of a portrait image in the other cell. Values are read from the class, so use the exact form split-NN / portrait-NNN.

options.label: centered, portrait-300, captioned
options.description: Equal story row of centred image cards (rider profiles): each image cell centred, its images at their own size. Optional: portrait-NNN, the display width in px of each card's first image; captioned, the paragraphs after that image are its caption (directly under it, light).

options.label: centered, text-center, text-small
options.description: Add to a centred story row: text-center centres the caption text, text-small sets it in 10pt.

options.label: offset-48-24
options.description: Story row whose cells start lower, from 720px wide: one number per cell, in px, in cell order (offset-48-24: the first cell 48px down, the second 24px). Use 0 for a cell that stays at the top.

options.label: centered, pad-m-15-15-15-15
options.description: Story row with its own padding inside the row, in px (top-right-bottom-left): pad-… from 781px wide, pad-m-… up to 780px (the Miss Peaches profile rows: 15px round on phones).

options.label: banners
options.description: Press kit: a row of linked banner images at their authored size (PDF download / share buttons).

options.label: callout
options.description: Press kit: [icon, text], a small 50px icon beside its text (the WhatsApp callout).

options.label: stats
options.description: Model page technical data: each cell is a key figure, the value in bold and its label below.
